chunks: And he who is given his ledger in his right hand
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a person is given their book in their right hand on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, receiving the book in the right hand signifies not only the ease of reckoning but also the spiritual purity and readiness of the believer, often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt's intercession and divine grace. This imagery contrasts sharply with the left-handed reception, which denotes disgrace and the burden of unrepented sins, a theme frequently elaborated in tafsirs like Al-Mizan. The verse serves as a pivotal eschatological marker, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the tangible reality of the Hereafter and the moral accountability of individual deeds.
